ValidationRule.description: Ensuring that all required fields are populated: Contact Name (Contact) Contact Phone (Case) Street Address (Case) Suburb (Case) Postcode (Case) State (Case) Country (Case)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Bag Replacement'), OR( ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.ContactId ), ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.Contact_Phone__c ), ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.Street__c ), ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.Suburb__c ), ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.Post_Code__c ), ISBLANK( Case_Number__r.State__c ), ISPICKVAL( Case_Number__r.Country__c, '' ) ),false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure all of the following fields are populated on the case: Contact Name, Contact Phone, Street Address, Suburb, Postcode, State and Country.
